scope.context_limit: Only the named boundary strips; do not analyze other adjacent-page text or diagrams. If insufficient, checkpoint a missing-context blocker for a new scoped session.
scope.preservation: Keep all 44 pages, all nonassigned region/link/evidence records and registry bindings unchanged. Remove only four assigned placeholder memberships; retain their old registry entries. Preserve the existing page-25 context record, its evidence and links. Append new assigned regions/evidence and narrowly scoped context regions; no ancestor baseline or report substitution.
scope.evidence_generation: Generate every new region/component crop, text and image serially in the current Python process using installed tooling. No multiprocessing, worker pools or external service. Recheck source and input hashes before and after.

replays.requirement: Run two separate complete independent regenerations from the pinned author input and persisted registry into absent directories. Each replay regenerates the entire new region/component set, not a sample or copied evidence. Freeze exact commands, pins and output-set comparisons. Compare stable IDs, author fields, geometry, reading order, links, coverage and payload hashes after explicitly normalizing only output-path-dependent fields; preserve both raw outputs and explain any engine metadata differences.

report_contracts.region-ledger.json: Complete assigned-page region accounting: stable IDs/keys, kind, box, reading order, evidence IDs, coverage statuses, uncertain readings and all leftovers. Retain a structural preservation index for nonassigned entries without re-reading their source content.
report_contracts.component-ledger.json: Enumerate every visible component of both page-28 diagrams and any other assigned diagram/artwork/table: counters, markers, annotations, arrows, legends and labels. Pin parent region, box and fresh evidence per component. Nested component observations have zero additional inventory denominator and do not create overlapping inventory boxes.
report_contracts.continuations.json: Pin every within-page/column and cross-page continuation endpoint and evidence; preserve cross-batch links and inherited context. Include assigned_range_entry and assigned_range_exit with physical_page 25 and 28 respectively, explicit observation, exact endpoint IDs and page-24/page-29 context-only locators. Empty prior boundary projection is unknown, not absence.
report_contracts.coverage-report.json: Report separate full-44-page inventory, assigned-page inventory and context-only ID sets/counts; check set equality and disjointness where applicable. Preserve nonassigned unprocessed gaps; count exclusions and uncertainty visibly. Context contributes zero denominator. Geometry, substantive accounting, transcription, descriptive/formal semantics and executable readiness remain separate.
report_contracts.source-pins.json: Pin actual accepted baseline inventory/registry, every current report, original source/provenance, original-page render evidence, every fresh region/component evidence input and two replay outputs. Locators carry source SHA, physical page, region/component ID, box, exact path, bytes and SHA-256. No obsolete placeholder source paths.
report_contracts.toolchain.json: Pin actual interpreter, bundled process_pythonpath (both repo/src and bundled site-packages), process_path_prefix, resolved Poppler binaries and hashes, library/engine versions and rendering settings. Preserve process-local inherited settings; no installs or global changes.
report_contracts.original-page-inspection.json: Fresh executor visual inspection of all four original assigned pages, both columns, notes/examples/diagrams, proposed boundaries/components and exact permitted adjacent strips. Pin source/render hashes and observations. Coordinator observations do not transfer inspection claims.
report_contracts.preservation-report.json: Compare the complete baseline and result internally. Prove every nonassigned page and region, all inherited evidence/links, existing registry entries and bindings remain unchanged; assigned-page geometry/source identity unchanged. Show exactly four placeholder memberships retired, no other deletion, and new IDs/links/evidence restricted to the assigned/context scope. Freeze counts and hashes without dumping unassigned source text.
report_contracts.replay-report.json: Pin both complete independent replay command logs, all input/output hashes, complete target-set equality, component equality, stable registry identity and normalized comparison results; no partial/sampled replay.
report_contracts.validation-report.json: Freeze exact commands, exits and report/log hashes, full/task/context denominators, artifact validation and unresolved limits; green structure is not human semantic acceptance.

original_acceptance: Account for every page region: clauses, headings, notes, examples, diagrams, tables/legends and editorial exclusions.
Keep exact evidence locators, uncertain readings and cross-page continuations; no silent omission.
Independent review compares the assigned pages against the complete region ledger.
original_tests: Validate coverage and locators; visual source review of every assigned page.
Check boundary references and context-only regions do not inflate denominator.
additional_acceptance: Use the hash-pinned accepted IG-2B06 full 44-page inventory and companion identity registry; preserve all nonassigned records, inherited evidence/links and registry bindings. Retire only the four pages-25-28 placeholder memberships without deleting registry entries.

Freshly inspect every original assigned page, column, note, example, diagram and component; pin exact source/page/box evidence for all new regions and components, uncertainty and explicit gaps. Boundary context is limited to the authorized page-24 bottom and page-29 top strips and contributes zero denominator.

Freeze final-verified/inventory.json and identity-registry.json plus all root reports named in the refined contract under the new owned inventory-25-28-01 attempt. Keep complete full/task/context denominators separate and retain the persisted registry binding.

Generate evidence serially and complete two separate independent full replays, preserving every new region/component and checking complete target-set equality, stable IDs, evidence freshness, reading order, links and path-normalized output comparisons.

Obtain fresh independent technical/source-accounting review against original assigned pages, the complete region/component ledgers and the entire frozen delivery. Preserve all human semantic gates; this inventory grants no gameplay legality or executable readiness.
additional_tests: Verify every pinned input SHA-256 before/after execution; validate the final complete inventory against actual source bytes, all 44 physical page geometries, exact evidence and the companion registry.

Compare baseline/result internally: unchanged nonassigned records/evidence/links and all existing registry entries; exactly four placeholder memberships removed; additions restricted to assigned/context scope; no stale source-reference index pins.

Verify complete region/component and continuation endpoint sets, two independent replay target-set equalities, complete full/task/context denominators and zero context contribution; explicitly retain remaining unprocessed pages and all uncertainty.

Run both complete serial evidence replays in separate fresh directories and freeze actual invocation commands, output hashes and comparison reports; review every original assigned page and every fresh region/component crop independently.
review_gate: Fresh independent reviewer identity and configuration must assess the entire frozen manifest, original assigned pages and every criterion before acceptance. No coordinator/executor source-semantic acceptance is inherited.
authorization_limits: This refines readiness only. No product delivery, source-meaning acceptance, downstream work or executor launch is asserted.
command_refinement: Use the installed pinned bundled pwsh. Windows PowerShell refused script startup under its execution policy. Script, validation arguments, tests and assertions remain unchanged; no policy/configuration change or bypass flag.
